draft_en.subject: Managed industrial PoE for your Pristina and Skopje projects - from ISAF
draft_en.body:
Hi Alban,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth about managed industrial PoE.

The unit: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ (240 W budget) + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed with ring redundancy, Marvell-based, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS - model STI-288DGGPM - $137.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). For larger cabinets, a 16 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP industrial unmanaged unit, STI-21616GP, $177.5.

One question: how many units does your next infrastructure project in Pristina or Skopje need?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
